findings.evidence: inventory uses UP.rglob('*.v'); direct recursive literal-include resolution of current UP .v sources plus soc_cpu_tb resolves exactly config.v, e203_defines.v and i2c_master_defines.v, all already present in that inventory. Current UP has no .vh/.vi and no unresolved literal include.
findings.correction: Do not report the current implementation as missing actual include files. Earlier concern based solely on .vh/.vi omission was an inference disproved by inspecting the current tree.
findings.future_hardening: For packaging/future include additions use actual preprocessor dependency closure or explicit include manifests and verify upstream both before/after. Include symlink targets/content/source manifest in binding; current config.v symlink bytes are already hashed by inventory.

positive_findings.result: soc_cpu_tb instantiates actual e203_cpu_shell, shared RAM and candidate ICB adapter. Testbench writes firmware/initial public shared fixture only; expected arrays are TB-only. Driver emits loads from shared SRAM, repacks W and drains candidate outputs; no neural dot-product/BFM answer substitution found.

Every accepted CPU shared Y/flags store is checked for correct mask/index/value and duplicate identity; output and flag response counts are tracked. Successful mailbox response additionally checks each destination word/byte in shared RAM against TB-only expected arrays. Destinations in generated fixture are poisoned with 0xa5. This is stronger than counts/checksum alone.

CPU phase store occurs before revd_opt_run reads/moves X/W/b or emits BEGIN. Cold start is actual shared phase-write command acceptance; end is last output/flag shared response handshake, inclusive difference+1. It includes driver setup, all input/parameter CPU loading, MMIO, compute, result drain/writeback. Host fixture preparation and initial config reads are outside; label as local CPU window, not official platform timing.

WINDOW begin is actual in_valid&&in_ready&&opBEGIN; end is actual out_valid&&out_ready&&out_last. Measured frontend elapsed=end-begin, core elapsed=end-STARTretire. Gate reconciles elapsed with live counters; comparison uses matched synthetic arrays, shift8, source-gap pattern, sink seed, PM4 and corresponding LAT1/LAT2. Core comparison is explicitly scoped proxy, not CPU/contest throughput. Timestamp correction already known by root is not duplicated as a new finding.

New run directories use mkdir(exist_ok=False), logs/results live under reports/revd_offline. Baseline alias is written under separate work subdir with transform record. No invocation of fixed old e203-ffn1 report path found.

budget_check.timeout_teardown: Linux creates a new session and SIGKILLs own child process group, waits at most10s; original15s deadline reserve includes teardown. No global process kill.
